verses.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.pt: Então Elifaz, o temanita, respondeu, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
verses.en_bbe: Then Eliphaz the Temanite made answer and said,

verses.en: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.pt: Por acaso o homem será de algum proveito a Deus? Pode ele se beneficiar de algum sábio?
verses.en_web: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for a man to be of profit to God? No, for a man's wisdom is only of profit to himself.

verses.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.pt: É útil ao Todo-Poderoso que sejas justo? Ganha ele algo se os teus caminhos forem íntegros?
verses.en_web: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?
verses.en_bbe: Is it of any interest to the Ruler of all that you are upright? or is it of use to him that your ways are without sin?

verses.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.pt: Acaso ele te repreende e vem contigo a juízo por causa da tua reverência?
verses.en_web: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
verses.en_bbe: Is it because you give him honour that he is sending punishment on you and is judging you?

verses.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.pt: Ou não será por causa de tua grande malícia, e de tuas maldades que não têm fim?
verses.en_web: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
verses.en_bbe: Is not your evil-doing great? and there is no end to your sins.

verses.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.pt: Porque tomaste penhor a teus irmãos sem causa, e foste tu que tiraste as roupas dos nus.
verses.en_web: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.en_bbe: For you have taken your brother's goods when he was not in your debt, and have taken away the clothing of those who have need of it.

verses.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.pt: Não deste de beber água ao cansado, e negaste o pão ao faminto.
verses.en_web: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
verses.en_bbe: You do not give water to the tired traveller, and from him who has no food you keep back bread.

verses.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.pt: Porém o homem poderoso teve a terra; e o homem influente habitava nela.
verses.en_web: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
verses.en_bbe: For it was the man with power who had the land, and the man with an honoured name who was living in it.

verses.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.pt: Às viúvas despediste vazias, e os braços dos órfãos foram quebrados.
verses.en_web: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.en_bbe: You have sent widows away without hearing their cause, and you have taken away the support of the child who has no father.

verses.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.pt: Por isso que há laços ao redor de ti, e espanto repentino te perturbou;
verses.en_web: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
verses.en_bbe: For this cause nets are round your feet, and you are overcome with sudden fear.

verses.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.pt: Ou trevas, para que não vejas; e inundação de água te cobre.
verses.en_web: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
verses.en_bbe: Your light is made dark so that you are unable to see, and you are covered by a mass of waters.

verses.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.pt: Por acaso Deus não está na altura dos céus? Olha, pois, para o cume das estrelas, como estão elevadas.
verses.en_web: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.en_bbe: Is not God as high as heaven? and see the stars, how high they are!

verses.en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.pt: Porém tu dizes: O que Deus sabe? Como ele julgará por entre a escuridão?
verses.en_web: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
verses.en_bbe: And you say, What knowledge has God? is he able to give decisions through the deep dark?

verses.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.pt: As nuvens são seu esconderijo, e ele não vê; ele passeia pela abóbada do céu.
verses.en_web: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
verses.en_bbe: Thick clouds are covering him, so that he is unable to see; and he is walking on the arch of heaven.

verses.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.pt: Por acaso deste atenção para o velho caminho que pisaram os homens injustos?
verses.en_web: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
verses.en_bbe: Will you keep the old way by which evil men went?

verses.en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.pt: Tais foram cortados antes de tempo; sobre o fundamento deles foi derramada uma enchente.
verses.en_web: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
verses.en_bbe: Who were violently taken away before their time, who were overcome by the rush of waters:

verses.en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.pt: Eles diziam a Deus: Afasta-te de nós! O que o Todo-Poderoso pode fazer por nós?
verses.en_web: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
verses.en_bbe: Who said to God, Go away from us; and, What is the Ruler of all able to do to us?

verses.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.pt: Sendo ele o que havia enchido suas casas de bens. Seja, porém, longe de mim o conselho dos perversos.
verses.en_web: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.en_bbe: Though he made their houses full of good things: but the purpose of the evil-doers is far from me!

verses.en: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.pt: Os justos virão e se alegrarão; e o inocente os escarnecerá,
verses.en_web: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
verses.en_bbe: The upright saw it and were glad: and those who had done no wrong made sport of them,

verses.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.pt: Dizendo: Certamente nossos adversários foram destruídos, e o que sobrou deles o fogo consumiu.
verses.en_web: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
verses.en_bbe: Saying, Truly, their substance is cut off, and their wealth is food for the fire.

verses.en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.pt: Reconcilia-te, pois, com Deus,e terás paz; assim o bem virá a ti.
verses.en_web: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.
verses.en_bbe: Put yourself now in a right relation with him and be at peace: so will you do well in your undertakings.

verses.en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.pt: Aceita, pois, a instrução de sua boca, e põe suas palavras em teu coração.
verses.en_web: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
verses.en_bbe: Be pleased to take teaching from his mouth, and let his words be stored up in your heart.

verses.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.pt: Se te converteres ao Todo-Poderoso, serás edificado; se afastares a maldade de tua tenda,
verses.en_web: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
verses.en_bbe: If you come back to the Ruler of all, making yourself low before him; if you put evil far away from your tents;

verses.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.pt: E lançares teu ouro no pó, o ouro de Ofir junto às rochas dos ribeiros,
verses.en_web: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
verses.en_bbe: And put your gold in the dust, even your gold of Ophir among the rocks of the valleys;

verses.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.pt: Então o próprio Todo-Poderoso será teu ouro, e tua prata maciça.
verses.en_web: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Ruler of all will be your gold, and his teaching will be your silver;

verses.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.pt: Porque então te deleitarás no Todo-Poderoso, e levantarás teu rosto a Deus.
verses.en_web: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.
verses.en_bbe: For then you will have delight in the Ruler of all, and your face will be lifted up to God.

verses.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.pt: Orarás a ele, e ele te ouvirá; e tu lhe pagarás teus votos.
verses.en_web: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.
verses.en_bbe: You will make your prayer to him, and be answered; and you will give effect to your oaths.

verses.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.pt: Aquilo que tu determinares se cumprirá a ti, e em teus caminhos a luz brilhará.
verses.en_web: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.
verses.en_bbe: Your purposes will come about, and light will be shining on your ways.

verses.en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.pt: Quando alguém for abatido, e tu disseres: Haja exaltação, Então Deus salvará ao humilde.
verses.en_web: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
verses.en_bbe: For God makes low those whose hearts are lifted up, but he is a saviour to the poor in spirit.

verses.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.pt: Ele libertará até ao que não é inocente, que será livrado pela pureza de tuas mãos.
verses.en_web: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
verses.en_bbe: He makes safe the man who is free from sin, and if your hands are clean, salvation will be yours.
